# couchbase-capella_app_service_admin_user (Resource)

Manages an admin user of an App Service in Couchbase Capella. Set either `access_all_endpoints = true` or a non-empty `endpoints` set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "couchbase-capella_app_service_admin_user" "new_admin_user" {
  organization_id = "<organization_id>"
  project_id      = "<project_id>"
  cluster_id      = "<cluster_id>"
  app_service_id  = "<app_service_id>"
  name            = "admin-user"
  password        = "<password>"
  endpoints       = ["<app_endpoint_name>"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_service_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the appService.
- `cluster_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the cluster.
- `name` (String) - The name of the user.
- `organization_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the organization.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) - The password of the user.
- `project_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the project.

### Optional

- `access_all_endpoints` (Boolean) - Give user access to all App Endpoints.
- `endpoints` (Set of String) - The list of App Endpoints that the user has access to.

### Read-Only

- `audit` (Attributes) Couchbase audit data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--audit))
- `id` (String) - The unique identifier for the user.
